events.title: New Night Machine demo update available now!
events.summary: We've got another demo update ready for you, and this one's packed with additions to the core experience.Ornaments The big new feature this patch. After certain combat encounters, you'll earn ornaments that attach to your ship's windshield. They come in different rarities and carry passive modifiers that stay active for your entire run, things like "if your shields are at 0, increase damage by 50%."
